description: Angular component for rendering a real-time updating chart using Chart.js, displaying streamed numeric data with time labels.

classes.name: RealtimeChartComponent
classes.description: Angular component that displays a live updating line chart for streaming numeric data, with inputs for data and methods to create and update the chart.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that initializes the chart after the component's view has been fully initialized.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates the chart when input data changes.

methods.name: createChart
methods.description: Creates a new Chart.js line chart instance with current data.

methods.name: updateChart
methods.description: Efficiently updates the existing chart with new data during real-time streaming.
